content.title: What Time Does ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 Come Out? How To Watch Tonight
content.text: ZendayaCourtesy of Warner Bros.It’s been a long wait, but the third and (potentially) final season of HBO’s Emmy-winning drama, Euphoria, returns tonight. Read on to learn what time to tune in, how to watch and everything to know about Season 3, including the new and returning cast.Euphoria was renewed for a third season in February 2022, but in March 2024, HBO announced that production on Season 3 had been indefinitely delayed. The pause was likely due to several factors, including the 2023 actor and screenwriter strikes and the cast’s surge in popularity, including Zendaya, Jacob Elordi and Sydney Sweeney. Filming eventually got underway in early 2025.Forbes‘Euphoria’ Season 3 Release Schedule Runs Through May: What To KnowPlot details for the upcoming chapter have been kept under wraps, but the teens are transitioning into adulthood. HBO’s second trailer shows Rue (Zendaya) being interrogated in Mexico after working with drug dealers, Cassie (Sweeney) and Nate (Elordi) getting married, and offers a glimpse of what the characters are doing post–high school.Here’s the official synopsis from HBO: “A group of childhood friends wrestle with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption, and the problem of evil.”Alexa DemieCourtesy of Warner Bros.Euphoria Season 3 premieres on Sunday, April 12, at 9 p.m. ET on HBO and HBO Max.How To Watch Euphoria Season 3 On StreamingHunter SchaferCourtesy of Warner Bros.The third season of Euphoria is available to stream on HBO Max. To watch the series, you’ll need to sign up for a subscription to the platform. The streaming site currently offers three subscription plans: Basic with ads is $10.99 per month, Standard is $18.49 per month and Premium is $22.99/month. You can also sign up for the Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle, where you have access to Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max for $19.99 per month with ads and $32.99 per month without ads. Learn more on HBO Max’s plans and prices page.ForbesThe Best New TV Shows Streaming In April 2026 On Netflix, HBO Max And MoreBy Monica MercuriHow To Watch Euphoria Season 3 On CableAt the same time, Euphoria will start streaming on HBO Max, and the series will air live on HBO at 9 p.m. ET. You can subscribe to HBO through your television provider, which also gives you access to HBO’s full schedule of programming.Who’s In The Euphoria Season 3 Cast?Sydney SweeneyCourtesy of Warner Bros.The returning cast includes Zendaya, Hunter Schafer, the late Eric Dane, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, Alexa Demie, Maude Apatow and Colman Domingo. Alanna Ubach, Daeg Faerch, Dominic Fike, Melvin Gregg, Nika King, Paula Marshall, Sophia Rose Wilson and Zak Steiner will also return for Season 3. Martha Kelly and Chloe Cherry have been promoted to series regulars.Deadline exclusively reported on the large number of additions to Season 3, including musician Rosalía, Marshawn Lynch and Kadeem Hardison. New cast members also include Darrell Britt-Gibson, Priscilla Delgado, James Landry Hébert, Anna Van Patten, Trisha Paytas, Bella Podaras, Bill Bodner, Cailyn Rice and Colleen Camp, among others.Who’s Not Returning For Season 3?BEVERLY HILLS, CALIFORNIA - MARCH 27: Angus Cloud attends the 2022 Vanity Fair Oscar Party hosted by Radhika Jones at Wallis Annenberg Center for the Performing Arts on March 27, 2022 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo by Dimitrios Kambouris/WireImage)WireImageAngus Cloud, who played Fezco on the show, passed away in July 2023 from an accidental overdose at the age of 25. Euphoria creator Sam Levinson told The Hollywood Reporter how the show will honor Cloud in the upcoming season.“I couldn’t keep him alive in real life but I could keep his character [Fezco] alive in the show,” Levinson explained. “I kept him alive and the character has got a great arc. I think he’d be very proud of it.”ForbesActor Angus Cloud Died Of Accidental Overdose Of Fentanyl, Cocaine And Other DrugsBy Molly BohannonBarbie Ferreira will not reprise her role as Kat, the actress announced on Instagram Story in August 2022. Austin Abrams, who played Kat’s boyfriend Ethan, will also not return.“After four years of getting to embody the most special and enigmatic character Kat, I’m having to say a very teary-eyed goodbye,” Ferreira wrote at the time, according to Variety. “I hope many of you could see yourself in her like I did and that she brought you joy to see her journey into the character she is today. I put all my care and love into her and I hope you guys could feel it. Love you Katherine Hernandez.”BEVERLY HILLS, CALIFORNIA - JANUARY 05: (L-R) Maude Apatow, Hunter Schafer, Barbie Ferreira, Sydney Sweeney and Storm Reid attends The 2020 InStyle And Warner Bros. 77th Annual Golden Globe Awards Post-Party at The Beverly Hilton Hotel on January 05, 2020 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for InStyle)Getty Images for InStyleAdditionally, Storm Reid, who played the younger sister of Rue (Zendaya), will not be involved in Season 3.“Unfortunately, Gia’s not returning for the third season, but I’m so, so indebted to the cast and crew of that show [and] to HBO. Euphoria is a really special thing,” Reid said to Rotten Tomatoes at the 2024 Governors Awards, per The Hollywood Reporter.HBO Max dropped the trailer for the upcoming season on April 3.
